verdict.rationale: Linear's Loops let users describe a recurring job in plain language and choose whether it runs on a schedule or in response to an event. Event triggers now cover changes to initiatives, projects and cycles, and documented examples include auto-updating docs or launch plans and posting Slack messages when a project's target date changes. Missing for 10: detail on schedule configuration (frequency/timing options) beyond changelog snippets, and independent or hands-on corroboration that Loops work as described.
